name: overview
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide editorial illustration for a Korean university beginner cybersecurity textbook, landscape banner about 3:1 aspect ratio. Create refined, professionally art-directed 1990s retro pixel-office art, crisp deliberate pixel clusters and subtle limited-palette shading, NOT a generic vector diagram or three identical monitor icons. Cream paper background #fffdf8, ink navy #263449, teal #287f78, warm ochre #b96c24, muted blue #426b9b. Scene: a cohesive isometric cutaway security learning office, with three distinct visually separated zones left to right: a student seated at a beige CRT workstation typing a single command with notebook on desk; a compact laboratory server rack with visible patch cables and small paper event records; a security analyst at a different desk studying a large magnified event record beside a restrained dashboard. Warm book illustration mood, detailed objects and believable office furniture, no hoodies, no cyberpunk neon, no green code rain. Generous clear cream space around zones, entire scene fully inside frame, strong silhouettes readable when printed 15 cm wide. No labels, no letters, no digits, no logos, no arrows, no fake readable software UI. This is an educational concept illustration, not a screenshot. Avoid dense tiny detail, gradients and blur.
role: 생성형 개념 삽화. 실제 실행 화면이 아님.
